name: Skinning rack
examine: Pegs, hooks and a lot of old stains. For basin wildlife.

name: Lye vat
examine: A glazed vat of lye. Scalth creatures come apart in it without taking your hands with them.

name: Synod strongbox
examine: Iron, red paint and the seal of the Sanguine Synod. Whatever goes in is recorded in a ledger somewhere.

name: Apothecary's still
examine: Copper coils under the counter, warm to the touch. Not the kind of thing an honest apothecary owns.

actions.label: Distil
actions.lockedMessage: That's Corvin's, and it's behind his counter. Perhaps ask him about it.

name: Waystone
examine: A mossy marker stone on Palmerway, cut with the Synod's drop of blood.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: CRUOR, ELEVEN DAYS EAST. TOLLING, AN HOUR WEST. Under the second line someone has scratched a small bell.

name: Waygate
examine: A wardens' gate in the palisade, sealed with Synod wax. The road to Cruor runs on beyond it.

actions.label: Open
actions.lockedMessage: Barred from the far side. A notice under the seal reads: THE ROAD TO CRUOR IS CLOSED UNTIL THE CAUSEWAY IS MENDED. BY ORDER OF THE WARDENS.

name: Cruorian monument
examine: A red stone needle on a stepped plinth, raised by Cruor where the road leaves Tolling. Its founts are cut into the steps.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: THE BLOOD OF THE MANY IS THE KEEPING OF THE BAY. GIVE, AND BE KEPT. Below, in smaller letters: Raised in the forty-first year of the Keeping, by the faithful of Palmerway.

name: Fount
examine: A bowl cut into the monument's step, ringed with little bronze teeth. It is never quite dry.

node.startMessage: You push your arm into the fount. The teeth close, and it drinks.
node.depletedMessage: The fount is sated. Another will wake.

surge.message: One of the monument's founts wakes hungry.

name: The Unquiet Saint
examine: A martyr of Cruor on his bier, under a red pall. He should be dust by now. He is not quite.

actions.label: Pray
actions.message: You kneel at the bier and begin to pray. High above, the stone face seems to bow a little lower. (The Requiem itself is not built yet.)

name: Holy symbol
examine: A bronze symbol set high on a pillar. It catches light that isn't there.

name: Altar
examine: Where the faithful pour what they've given. The Requiem is sung here.

name: Offertory
examine: A bronze basin for what the Saint says is owed.

name: Fount
examine: A bowl ringed with little bronze teeth, like the monuments' above. Older.

name: Sigil
examine: A drop cut into the floor inside a bronze ring. The Saint's debts are not collected here.

name: Stair
examine: The way back up to the monument.

actions.label: Climb
actions.message: The stair leads up to a sealed door. (Blockout: the way out comes with instancing.)

name: The First Monument
examine: The needle every other Cruorian monument is copied from. The founts around it never quite empty.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: HERE THE MANY GAVE, AND THE BAY WAS KEPT. EVERY MONUMENT IN THE WORLD IS A DRAWING OF THIS ONE. Below, cut deep and recut many times: KEEP.

name: High altar
examine: The high altar of the Vigil. The cloth on it is changed every hour, and never washed.

name: Proclamation
examine: A Synod proclamation, nailed up over older ones.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: BY ORDER OF THE PONTIFF OF CRUOR: the Letting House is open from first bell to last. Pilgrims are bled in the order they arrive. Those who sleep and do not wake are to be reported to the Vigil, not buried.

name: Letting chair
examine: A leather chair with a strap for the arm and a copper bowl beneath. The bowl drains into a channel in the floor.

actions.label: Give-blood
actions.message: A Sister of the Letting takes your wrist, looks at the vein for a long moment, and lets it go. 'Not you. Not yet. Something has already had its share of you.'

name: The Watch
examine: A long stone rail over the bay, worn smooth where people lean on it to look at the Quaere.

actions.label: Keep-vigil
actions.message: You watch the Quaere across the Cradle for a while. The water breathes in, and out. Nothing else moves. That is the point of the Watch.

name: Shuttered shop
examine: An apothecary's sign, painted over. The shutters are new, and the lock is newer.

actions.label: Knock
actions.message: Nobody answers. Behind the shutters something stops bubbling, as if it had been listening.

name: Sky-glass
examine: A brass telescope on a tripod outside the Concordian consulate. A small sign: FORECASTS WITHIN.

actions.label: Look-through
actions.message: The glass is aimed at the Quaere, not the sky. Someone has scratched tally marks along the brass, hundreds of them.

name: The toll board
examine: A tall black board in gilt letters: the toll on every cargo that leaves the bay, rewritten each season.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: GRAIN, the hundredweight: two marks. SALT, outbound: none (it is ours). PILGRIMS, the head: one mark, waived for the dead. BLOOD, in any vessel: not to pass. Masters will heave to under the Tollkeep and wait to be weighed.

name: Chain capstan
examine: The capstan that winds the chain across the Mouth. The bars are polished by hands; the chain is not.

actions.label: Look-at
actions.message: The chain runs from the Tollkeep down into the water and away across the Mouth on its floats. A tollman says it has been wound up three times in three hundred years, and each time Cruor paid to have it lowered.

name: The Balance
examine: The public scale of Tithe. Gold in one pan, salt in the other, and they hang level.

actions.label: Read-plaque
actions.message: The plaque reads: WHAT IS GIVEN WILL BE CALLED IN. BE FOUND LEVEL. Under it, smaller, someone has scratched: and Cruor?

name: The Ledger
examine: A book as wide as a door, open on a black lectern. Every soul in Tithe has a line in it.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: An auditor turns the great pages for you without being asked, finds the place where your name would go, and runs a finger down a column that is entirely empty. 'Not yet,' she says. 'But you were looked for.'

name: Altar
examine: The Chantry altar: an open ledger and a small gold balance on a plain stone block.

name: Saltery door
examine: A black door in a white wall, with no handle on this side.

actions.label: Knock
actions.message: A shutter opens at eye height. 'Living?' Yes. 'Then come back when you aren't, and we'll keep you for the reckoning.' The shutter closes.

name: Salt heap
examine: Raked salt from the pans of Salinas, drying in the glare.

actions.label: Look-at
actions.message: The salt is so white at noon it hurts to look at. The rakers wear veils; the heaps cast no shadow you can see.

name: The Deepwell
examine: The deepest well in the west: five terraces down to water you can see but not reach.

actions.label: Look-down
actions.message: Far below, the water is bright turquoise and perfectly still, except where the wheel dips into it. A guard watches you look. In Cistern, nobody draws from the Deepwell without a tally from the Water Office.

name: The Rolls
examine: Long scrolls listing every household's water ration, re-inked every dry season.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: House of the tanner Iskar: four jars the week. House of the widow Daoud: three jars, and one for the fig tree, by the Queen's mercy. Strangers and pilgrims: one cup the day, at the seller's price. At the bottom, in a newer hand: rations to be cut by a fifth from the new moon.

name: The dry fountain
examine: A great fountain basin, cracked dry. The green stains on the bowl are the only water it remembers.

actions.label: Look-at
actions.message: Coins lie in the cracks of the dry basin: people still throw them in, though nobody remembers what for. A water-seller watches you, in case you're thirsty.

name: Cistern stair
examine: Steps going down under the Great Cistern's dome into cool darkness. The air coming up smells of stone and water.

actions.label: Listen
actions.message: From deep under the dome comes the slow drip of water into a tank as big as a cathedral, and, once, something like a voice counting. Then only the drip.

name: Palace doors
examine: Gilded doors in the deep tiled arch of the palace.

actions.label: Enter
actions.message: Two guards cross their spears. 'The Queen hears petitions on the first day of the month. Bring water, or bring something better than water.'

name: Signpost
examine: A weathered signpost by the Pass Gate, its arms written in three scripts.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: NORTH: LUCERN PASS, AND CONCORDIA BEYOND (by the beacons). EAST: VENARIA AND THE CRADLE. Someone has added, under NORTH, in chalk: carry twice the water you think.

name: Gnomon plaque
examine: A brass plaque on the gnomon's plinth, polished by a great many thumbs.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: THIS LINE IS THE MERIDIAN OF CONCORDIA. ALL MEASURE BEGINS HERE. At noon the shadow lies on the brass. Under it, smaller: Corrected after the fall of the second year, by a hand's width.

name: Rostrum
examine: The rostrum of the Concord, a brass lectern and a sand-glass. The sand is all in the bottom.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The sand-glass is labelled ONE SPEAKER, ONE GLASS. Somebody has scratched beside it: the Synod's envoy turns it over when it's half done.

name: The standards
examine: A glazed case: the standard ell, a nest of brass weights, a balance.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Every ell and pound in Concordia is checked against these. A card in the case reads: The Synod's ell is three fingers shorter. Trade accordingly.

name: Almanac board
examine: The season's moonfall forecast, pinned up on slate and updated by semaphore.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: MOONFALL FORECAST. North-west sectors: likely. The Cradle: unlikely. Calcinia: none expected. Below, in a different hand and struck through: Revised upward. See Magister Varrow.

name: Fragment rail
examine: A brass rail round a piece of the cracked moon. The label on it is very small.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Fragment, Selenfall, eleventh year. Do not touch. Do not sleep within ten paces. The stone hums, low, just under hearing, and the green in it moves when you don't look at it.

name: Funicular gate
examine: The turnstile of the funicular up to the Orrery. Locked, with a brass plate.

actions.label: Ride
actions.message: The plate reads: ASCENTS BY APPOINTMENT OF THE ORRERY ONLY. The cable above you hums as a car comes down empty.

name: Toll board
examine: The tolls for the pass, painted white on slate.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: CROSSING TOLL, BY ORDER OF THE CONCORD. By head: one. By mule: three. By cart: by weight. Scholars of the Orrery, dwarves under the Treaty: none. Pilgrims of the Synod: by head, and no argument.

name: Notice
examine: A fresh notice on the survey office's board.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: SURVEY OF THE CONCORD. Bore Nine has reached its depth. All work suspended pending the Magister's review. Spoil is NOT to be taken home, burned, or eaten.

name: Survey sign
examine: A slate sign on the fence round the derrick.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: BORE NINE. AUTHORISED SURVEYORS ONLY. Under it, in chalk, in a dwarf's square letters: you are too deep.

name: Ladder
examine: Rungs worn smooth in the middle. It goes up.

name: Ladder
examine: Rungs worn smooth in the middle. It goes down.

name: Stairs
examine: A stair, going up.

name: Stairs
examine: A stair, going down.

name: Trapdoor
examine: A trapdoor with an iron ring. There are steps below.

name: Trapdoor
examine: The underside of a trapdoor, and a ladder up to it.

name: Cave mouth
examine: A dark opening in the rock. Cold air breathes out of it.

name: Cave exit
examine: Daylight, a long way up the passage.

name: Quay crane
examine: A timber jib crane on an iron turntable, its safe load chalked on the arm to the pound.

actions.label: Work
actions.message: You lean on the winch. The hook rises one notch a turn, exactly as the plate on the drum promises.

name: Shoal
examine: Silver backs turning in the green water under the quay.

actions.label: Net
actions.message: The shoal scatters at your shadow and comes straight back. A net would do better than hands.

name: Pool
examine: Cold water where the Cut meets the sea. Trout hang in the current, facing the mountain.

actions.label: Fish
actions.message: The trout don't move for you. They don't move for anything but a fly. A rod would help.

name: Fish stall
examine: Ice, wet baskets and a slate price list ruled into columns.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Today's catch, priced by the pound and by the hour: it gets cheaper as the day goes on, to a published schedule.

name: Cooking range
examine: An iron range with a firebox, and a thermometer bolted to the oven door.

name: Barometer
examine: A brass barometer by the inn door. Someone has scratched LIAR beside FAIR.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: The needle points at CHANGE. It always points at CHANGE, the landlord says, which makes it the most honest instrument in the city.

name: Hearth
examine: A big open fire of driftwood, banked high.

actions.label: Warm-hands
actions.message: The only fire in Meridian nobody has measured. Nobody wants to be the one who tries.

name: Bed
examine: A narrow bed, its blanket folded square to the wall.

actions.label: Rest
actions.message: You lie down for a moment. Someone has painted a grid on the ceiling, so there is always something to count.

name: Shipping board
examine: A slate board of berths, ships and tides.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: BERTH 2: the Even Keel, salt from Tithe. BERTH 5: empty. BERTH 6: the Due Course, overdue. Freshly chalked below: tides corrected again; see the Almanac Office.

name: Harbourmaster's log
examine: A heavy ledger, every line dated to the minute.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Arrivals, departures, weights. Twice this month an entry reads 'light on the water to the south-west, no vessel', and twice it has been struck out in another hand.

name: Chandlery shelves
examine: Rope by the fathom, lamp oil by the pint, tar by the bucket.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Everything a ship could want, labelled. The back shelf is labelled in a different hand, and it is all candles and chalk.

name: Cluttered table
examine: Candle stubs, a cracked bowl, chalk dust in the grain.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: A page of notes in a cramped hand: three circles, a line drawn through for the bile, and 'they measure everything but this'. The rest has been burned.

name: Gear bench
examine: A long bench for rods, nets and traps, hung with twine.

name: Sail loom
examine: A broad loom threaded with pale sailcloth.

name: Keel on the stocks
examine: A keel and its first ribs, every rib numbered in chalk.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: A slate hung on the stocks: KEEL 41. RIBS 1-9 OF 38. FINISH BY THE SECOND MOON. 'Second' has been underlined twice.

name: Cargo ledger
examine: A ledger of everything that crossed the quay, by number.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Bales in, crates out. A column headed 'Bore stores, uninsured' was started last spring, and then it stops.

name: Cold cellar hatch
examine: An iron hatch breathing cold air. The cellar under it is packed with ice cut from the mountain.

name: Hoard chest
examine: An iron-bound chest under the eaves.

actions.label: Search
actions.message: Rope ends, odd buttons, a dented sextant and somebody's lost wages, all sorted by size. You put it back as you found it.

name: Sailors' altar
examine: A plain altar under the one Synod lamp the city tolerates, ringed with votive ships.

name: Votive ships
examine: Little carved ships, one for every crew that came home.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Each has a name and a date cut into its keel. The Rationalists call religion a fever; the sailors keep carving.

name: Beacon lamp
examine: A great oil lamp behind lenses as tall as you are.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The keeper's log hangs beside it: LIT, LIT, LIT, every night for eleven years, and not one entry more.

name: Telescope
examine: A brass telescope on a pivot, aimed out to sea.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Past the breakwater the sea is empty to the horizon. To the south-west, where the log says lights were seen, there is a faint green sheen on the water.

name: Telescope
examine: A brass telescope on a pivot, aimed down at the city.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The whole city falls away below you, tier on tier, the brass line running straight down it to the sea. To the north the Orrery's slit is open.

name: Telescope
examine: A brass telescope on a pivot, aimed up the pass.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The beacon road climbs into the pass, a lamp tower every few miles. The nearest is lit. The one after it is not.

name: Notice board
examine: Errands, tasks and lost property, pinned in straight rows.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: WANTED: a steady pair of hands to carry an instrument to the Butts (fragile). WANTED: a second opinion on the Almanac (ask for no one). FOUND: one plumb-bob, slightly out of true.

name: Scales
examine: Brass scales and a box of weights, each stamped by the Hall of Measures.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: You try a weight on the scales. It is exactly what it says it is. Everything here is exactly what it says it is.

name: Chiming clock
examine: A tall case clock with a little brass grille under its face, like a mouth.

actions.label: Listen
actions.message: It whirs, and a small voice says: 'Ask the brass line where it goes. Then go there.' Then it chimes the quarter, a minute early.

name: Exchequer strongbox
examine: An iron strongbox behind the counter, stamped with the Exchequer's balance.

name: Vault door
examine: A round iron door with three dials.

actions.label: Open
actions.lockedMessage: The dials are set to numbers you don't know, and a clerk downstairs is watching you not know them.

name: Instrument bench
examine: A bench of half-made locks, sights and crossbow stocks.

name: Hour-stone
examine: A granite stone at the end of an hour-line.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: The hour is cut deep. Under it, cut later and smaller, a correction: add a hand's width, since the second year.

name: Little Orrery
examine: A brass armillary of the moons on a granite drum.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The moons turn on their rings. One is green glass, cracked right across, and someone has tried to glue it.

name: Fountain
examine: A square granite basin with a single jet.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: You put your hand in the jet. It is exactly one metre high. Of course it is.

name: Garden bench
examine: A bench on a strip of lawn mown to the height of every other strip.

actions.label: Sit
actions.message: You sit. The bench is perfectly level, and you find yourself checking.

name: Scholar's books
examine: Books on every flat surface, spines out.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Tables of moon-rise against tide, worked over and over. In the margin: 'The forecast is wrong. Not by much. Not by much yet.'

name: Letters
examine: A neat stack of letters, still sealed.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Every one is addressed to the Almanac Office, and every one has come back unopened, stamped NOTED.

name: Lectern
examine: A tall lectern with the day's lecture pinned to it.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: TODAY: On the Errors of the Ancients, with Corrections. TOMORROW: On the Errors of Today's Lecture.

name: Study door
examine: A blue door with a brass plate: THE PROFESSOR IS NOT IN.

actions.label: Open
actions.lockedMessage: Locked. A note asks for a field assistant to apply in person, which you can't, because the professor is not in.

name: Library shelves
examine: Shelves to the roof, catalogued by skill.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Every shelf is a skill, Artifice to Woodcutting, its books ranked by what a reader could make or do after them. The guide in your pack says much the same in fewer words.

name: Bestiary desk
examine: A desk under a lamp, and a great open book of creatures.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Each creature has its page: drawn, measured, weighed. The Moonborn pages are mostly blank, with a note: specimens wanted, whole if possible.

name: Roped-off shelf
examine: A shelf behind a velvet rope, the books on it bound in grey.

actions.label: Read
actions.lockedMessage: The rope is only velvet, but the librarian downstairs has very good hearing.

name: Specimen case
examine: Glass cases of beetles, ores and shells, labelled in brass.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Every specimen is pinned, named and measured. One tray of glowing green grit has no label at all.

name: Crag-goat
examine: A stuffed crag-goat, one horn mended with wire.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Its plaque says it was taken on the pine slope. Its glass eyes have been set perfectly level, so it looks surprised.

name: Moon-glass case
examine: A locked case of green glass beads.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Moon-glass: what the fragment sheds as it cools. The beads are warmer than the room. The label says DO NOT BREATHE ON.

name: Herb bed
examine: A raised bed of alpine herbs, each labelled in brass.

actions.label: Pick
actions.message: You rub a leaf: sharp and cold, a little like snow. The labels say what each one cures, with a margin of error.

name: Physic bench
examine: A physician's bench: a balance, a mortar and a rack of stoppered jars.

name: Brass telescope
examine: A brass telescope under the dome's slit.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: You find the moon and it fills the glass: grey, scarred, and very slightly closer than the ring on the eyepiece says it ought to be.

name: Brass telescope
examine: A brass telescope whose rings are engraved with the moon's phases.

actions.label: Turn
actions.message: The rings are set to the full moon, and tonight's is not full. A note on the mount: 'set it true, and look where it then points.'

name: Star charts
examine: Charts of the sky in sectors, pinned at every moonfall.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Every moonfall since the second year has its pin. The pins are getting closer together.

name: Assembly bench
examine: Plain dark wood, a numbered brass plate on every seat.

actions.label: Sit
actions.message: You take a seat. The plate says it belongs to someone, and that their attendance is recorded.

name: Crossbow rack
examine: Crossbows in rows, each tagged with its draw weight.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Every bow has a tag: weight, range, and who last sighted it. The tag on lane four's bow just says SEE ME.

name: Range ledger
examine: Scores by lane and by day.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Lane four's column has been wrong for a week, always by the same amount.

name: Target
examine: A straw boss on an easel, painted with rings.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: A tight cluster of holes a hand's width left of the gold, as if the target had moved.

name: Judges' bench
examine: A bench for three above the lanes.

actions.label: Watch
actions.message: From up here you can see every lane at once, and the bay beyond them, and a lot of marksmen pretending not to look up.

name: Rail telescope
examine: A brass telescope on the rail, with a coin slot that takes no coins.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: East over the bay: fishing boats, a trader beating in from Tithe, and the beacons stepping up the pass.

name: Forecast desk
examine: The desk where the day's forecast is written out in fair copy.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: TODAY: CLEAR. MOONFALL RISK: LOW. Beneath it in the same hand, struck through and written again: LOW (REVISED).

name: Semaphore levers
examine: Two brass levers that work the arms on the mast above.

actions.label: Work
actions.message: The arms clank overhead. Far up the pass a beacon's arms clank back: RECEIVED. Then, after a pause: REPEAT.

name: Telescope
examine: A brass telescope, aimed not at the sky but at the Orrery.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Through it you can see the Orrery's slit, and someone in it looking back at you through a much bigger one.

name: Winding wheel
examine: The great brass wheel that hauls the funicular, behind glass.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Still. A tag hangs on it: SEIZED? NO. STOPPED, BY ORDER.

name: Appointment book
examine: The ledger of ascents to the Orrery.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Every page for a year ahead is empty but one line: 'Field assistant (to be found). I. Varrow.'

name: The Orrery Gate
examine: Brass-bound iron gates across the meridian. A plaque: ASCENTS BY APPOINTMENT.

actions.label: Open
actions.lockedMessage: Locked. Under the plaque, smaller: AND NOT OTHERWISE.

name: View point
examine: A brass plate on the parapet, engraved with everything you can see from here.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Below: the Academy's lawns, the Library's roof, the Rows in their straight lines, and the gnomon's shadow lying exactly on the brass.

name: View point
examine: A brass plate on the parapet, engraved with everything you can see from here.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The harbour, the mole and its beacon, and the sea going on south. The plate names every berth; you can count the empty ones.

name: View point
examine: A brass plate on the parapet, engraved with everything you can see from here.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The Concord's dome and the Butts beside it on their arches over the sea. From here you hear each bow a moment after you see it.

name: Bench
examine: A granite bench on the Observers' Walk, facing the drop.

actions.label: Sit
actions.message: You sit with the whole city below you. The wind takes your breath away, which the plate on the bench says is the point.

name: Pocket orrery
examine: A little brass orrery on a post, the twin of the one in the Square.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Its moons turn with the big one's. Its green moon is cracked in the same place, though nobody has ever dropped this one.

name: Perch
examine: A flat rock past the end of the walk, out of the wind.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: From here you can see over the pines into the pass, and a camp no map shows: tents, a cart, and a derrick like Bore Nine's, smaller and newer.

name: Thicket
examine: A tangle of pine and scrub on the steep ground between the slope and the Crag.

name: Map table
examine: The Heights in survey, weighted flat with rock cores.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Every bore is numbered. Nine is circled. Ten to fourteen were drawn in pencil and rubbed out.

name: Glowing cores
examine: Rock cores in crates, banded grey and green.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: The green bands are warm to the touch. The crate is stencilled RETURN TO SURVEY, and then, freshly, DO NOT RETURN.

name: Shaft cover
examine: An iron cap bolted over the bore, every bolt painted with a seal.

actions.label: Open
actions.lockedMessage: Sealed by order of the Survey. The seals are fresh. The bolts under them are not.

name: Spoil heap
examine: Waste rock from the bore, faintly green and faintly warm.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Nothing grows on it, and nothing grows near it either.

name: Timetable
examine: The cart-line's timetable, chalked on slate.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: To the quay: hourly. To Frostpeak Forge: CLOSED. To the Deep Halls: ASK.

name: Trading counter
examine: A long counter of dark stone, banded in bronze.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: A sign in two hands, dwarven above and Concordian below: ALL WEIGHTS CHECKED BY BOTH PARTIES. The dwarven one adds: TWICE.

name: Stockroom chest
examine: The dwarves' bronze-bound stockroom chest, inside the door.

name: Furnace
examine: A dwarven furnace under a tall stack, roaring.

name: Anvil
examine: A frostiron anvil, its face polished like a mirror.

name: Ore cart
examine: An iron ore cart on the rails.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Half full of dull rock. Chalked on its side, in Concordian: WEIGHED. Underneath, in dwarven: REWEIGHED.

name: Sealed portal
examine: The Undergate's inner door, bronze on stone, shut.

actions.label: Open
actions.lockedMessage: A dwarf behind a grille says the door is open to friends of the Under-Treaty, and that you are not on the list yet.

name: Ironstone
examine: Brown ironstone in the side of the road cutting.

actions.label: Mine
actions.message: Good ore, close to the surface. You'll want a pick, and to know what to do with it.

name: Frostiron seam
examine: A seam of blue-white metal in the rock, rimed with frost.

actions.label: Mine
actions.message: Frostiron, cold enough to burn. The dwarves watch this seam closely, and you, now, just as closely.

name: Rubble
examine: A slope of fallen rock between the bends of the Ore Road.

name: Stepping stones
examine: Stepping stones across the Cut between the falls, slick with spray.

name: Wheels
examine: Cart wheels in stacks.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Every spoke is the same length, which the cartwrights will tell you is harder than it looks.

name: Bell
examine: The toll-house bell, for calling the clerk.

actions.label: Ring
actions.message: The bell rings out over the road. Below, the toll clerk looks up, then writes something down.

name: Carters' chest
examine: A strongbox the Wayhouse keeps for carters' goods.

name: Register
examine: Travellers by name, origin and weight of luggage.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: A caravan from Sere, three pilgrims from Cruor, and a surveyor who signed in and never signed out.

name: World map table
examine: R'th as the Guild has measured it, every coast to the inch.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: The far edges are blank and labelled UNSURVEYED, rather than anything more interesting. Your own world map opens from the minimap.

name: Diary desk
examine: A ledger of deeds done in the city and beyond, open for anyone to sign.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: The clerk checks every entry against the evidence. Your own deeds are kept in your journal's achievement diary.

name: Pale pine
examine: A pale mountain pine, its bark silver-grey.

actions.label: Chop
actions.message: Good straight timber. You'll want an axe, and the know-how to use it.

name: Berth post
examine: A granite post with an iron ring and a painted berth number.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: The number is repainted every spring, the plate under it says, in the same white, to the same height above the tide. The tide has been ignoring it.

name: Milestone
examine: A granite milestone at the foot of the road east.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: LUCERN PASS, 40 MILES. TITHE BY SEA, 3 DAYS. MERIDIAN, 0. Someone has chalked a fourth line: THE MOON, NEARER.

name: Clipped tree
examine: An evergreen clipped into a ball on a straight stem, in a granite tub.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Clipped to a perfect sphere. A brass tag on the tub gives the date of the last clipping, and of the next.

name: Span plaque
examine: A brass plaque set into the parapet at the end of the Span.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: THE SPAN. 17 METRES ABOVE THE CUT, 12 ACROSS, LEVEL TO A HAIR. RAISED UNDER THE UNDER-TREATY, BY BOTH PARTIES. The dwarven half of the text is a good deal longer.

name: Keeper's log
examine: The lamp-keeper's log, on a shelf by the door.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Oil in, oil burned, wick trimmed, glass cleaned; and in the last month, three nights marked 'lamp lit, but the light looked green.'

name: Waymark
examine: A granite waymark at the head of the Crag stair, arrows cut in its faces.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: UP: THE ORRERY GATE, THE BEACON. WEST: THE ALMANAC OFFICE. EAST: THE OBSERVERS' WALK. DOWN: THE ACADEMY, AND EVERYTHING ELSE.

name: View point
examine: A brass plate on the parapet, engraved with everything you can see from here.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Across the Gorge: the Span, the Undergate's bronze door in the mountain, Bore Nine's derrick, and the Cut falling white between them.

name: Cairn
examine: A cairn of squared stones at the foot of the knoll, every stone the same size.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Each stone is cut with a name and a year: the surveyors who measured the knoll. The newest stone has a name and no year.

name: Scoreboard
examine: A slate scoreboard on posts beside the firing line.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Today's best, lane by lane. Lane four: struck through, and beside it in the range master's hand: TARGET RE-SURVEYED. GROUND MOVED 2 CM.

name: Top landing
examine: The top landing of the Line Street stair, a brass rail along its edge.

actions.label: Look
actions.message: Straight down the brass line: the Rows, the gnomon, the Harbour Stair, the quay, the sea. Everything in Meridian is in a straight line from here, which is the point of it.

name: Drinking fountain
examine: A granite drinking fountain at the foot of the Harbour Stair.

actions.label: Drink
actions.message: Cold mountain water, a little metallic. A plate says it was tested this morning and found pure. A smaller plate says when it was last tested before that.

name: Statue
examine: A statue of a robed scholar holding a set square, on a plain plinth.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: THE FIRST OF THE RATIONALISTS, WHO MEASURED THE FEVER AND FOUND IT WANTING. The face has been left smooth: nobody agreed on what it looked like, so it was left uncut until they do.

name: Weather post
examine: A post on the Crag hung with a wind vane, a rain gauge and a thermometer.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: Wind north-east, light. Rain, none. Cold, as ever. A card in a brass frame is filled in every hour, and the last few are signed by people who were asked to stay later.

name: Treaty stone
examine: A tall dark stone carved in two scripts, Concordian and dwarven, side by side.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: THE UNDER-TREATY: what is above is Concordia's, what is beneath is the dwarves', and what is found between is shared. The last clause has been re-cut, deeper, by a dwarven hand.
